name: Karazhan’s Guardian’s Library
shortDescription: Karazhan’s Guardian’s Library, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Dark multi-level tower library with tall gothic columns, densely stacked books and galleries, brass lamps, wine-red cloth and cool arcane accents. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
